bestBets.overview: We race at Eagle Farm in Brisbane on Saturday with 10 races on the card. Track rated a soft (5) at acceptance time on Wednesday morning, the predicted Tuesday night rain didn't arrive & the forecast heading into the weekend is positive with temps in the mid 20's, we'll be going around on a good rated surface. Plenty of speed about in this opening race through nos.3, 4, 7 & 10, Idleonby who has shown great speed in both lead up trials likely to make use of her inside gate also. SPIRIT OF BARTY gets her chance, chased home a smart one her past couple & the likely solid tempo is a positive.

raceTips.comment: SPIRIT OF BARTY has been the runner up at her past three starts and the form around her is solid. With a month between runs, the drop back to 1000m will suit and she gets in beautifully with the claim. JIMMY’S BROTHER pulled up with a slow recovery when resuming, before scoring a a dominant 3.5 length victory at the Sunshine Coast last time. He strips fitter again and will take beating. HOWDOYOUZOU had no trouble stepping up in grade last start as he produced a strong on speed performance to finish a close third at the Sunshine Coast. Freshened, he’s since trialled well and from the low draw, he’ll be in it for a long way. GEITZ made it two from two this preparation with off an impressive last-to-first victory over 1200m at Doomben. Back to 1000m will suit and I think she’ll enjoy getting onto the big Eagle Farm track.
